Week 4 – Global Gender Inequality Analysis

2026-11-06

1. Introduction

This practical analyses changes in the Gender Inequality Index (GII) between 2010 and 2019 using R.

2. Data Sources

GII data were obtained from UNDP Human Development Reports. Country boundaries were obtained from Natural Earth.

3. Methodology

The GII data were cleaned and joined with country-level spatial data.

GII Change = GII (2019) - GII (2010)

Negative values indicate a decrease in gender inequality, while positive values indicate an increase.

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(countrycode)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
list.files()
gii <- read_excel("hdr-data.xlsx")
View(gii)
names(gii)
head(gii)
str(gii)
gii_filtered <- gii %>%
  filter(
    indicatorCode == "gii",
    year %in% c("2010", "2019")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    actualValue = as.numeric(actualValue)
  )
View(gii_filtered)
gii_wide <- gii_filtered %>%
  select(countryIsoCode, country, year, actualValue) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = year,
    values_from = actualValue,
    names_prefix = "GII_"
  )
View(gii_wide)
gii_wide <- gii_wide %>%
  mutate(
    GII_change = GII_2019 - GII_2010
  )
View(gii_wide)
names(gii_wide)
head(gii_wide)
world <- ne_countries(
  scale = "medium",
  returnclass = "sf"
)
head(world)
names(world)
plot(st_geometry(world))
world_gii <- world %>%
  left_join(
    gii_wide,
    by = c("adm0_a3" = "countryIsoCode")
  )
names(world_gii)
head(
  world_gii %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    select(name, GII_2010, GII_2019,GII_change)
)
sum(!is.na(world_gii$GII_change))
sum(is.na(world_gii$GII_change))
gii_map <- ggplot(world_gii) +
  geom_sf(
    aes(fill = GII_change),
    color = "grey50",
    linewidth = 0.1
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "blue",
    mid = "white",
    high = "red",
    midpoint = 0,
    na.value = "grey85",
    name = "GII Change"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Global Gender Inequality Change",
    subtitle = "2010–2019",
    caption = "Source: UNDP Human Development Reports"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

print(gii_map)
ggsave(
  filename = "GII_change_map.png",
  plot = gii_map,
  width = 12,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300
)
list.files()
st_write(
  world_gii,
  "world_gii.geojson",
  delete_dsn = TRUE
)
list.files()

4. Results

The map shows global changes in gender inequality between 2010 and 2019.

5. Conclusion

The analysis highlights geographical differences in gender inequality changes across countries.
